season_context.local_season_notes: Cool, dry winter from November to February, colder in the north, so khaddar, karandi and velvet ranges sell now. Wedding season runs roughly November to February. Ramadan is expected around February 2027, with Eid ul-Fitr around 9-11 March 2027, followed by the summer lawn season.

sources.title: The complete guide to choosing your Pakistani bridal dress in 2026

trends.name: Heavier printed khaddar
trends.summary: Gul Ahmed's winter 2026 range centres on printed khaddar and cotton, with this season's khaddar given a weightier hand aimed at shoppers in colder parts of the country; some unstitched sets add small embroidered panels or borders.

trends.name: Geometric and abstract over florals
trends.summary: For winter 2026, Gul Ahmed reports that bolder geometric and abstract motifs are displacing classic floral layouts on printed winter suits.

trends.name: Earthy winter neutrals
trends.summary: Winter 2026 prints lean on warm, grounded shades such as burnt sienna, camel, moss green and a dusty rose, per Gul Ahmed's season guide.

trends.name: Embroidered karandi three-piece suits
trends.summary: NAQSHI's winter launch uses textured karandi as the base for three-piece suits with embroidered shirts, matching trousers and dupatta, combining contrast trims with traditional shalwar-and-long-shirt shapes.
trends.source: NAQSHI press release via AB Newswire

trends.name: Velvet capes, gowns and culottes
trends.summary: Velvet is being cut into fluid shapes such as capes, long gown-style shirts and flared or culotte bottoms, sometimes with silk accents, according to NAQSHI's October winter release.
trends.source: NAQSHI press release via AB Newswire

trends.name: Luxury pret in raw silk and khaddar
trends.summary: Zara Shahjahan's fall 2026 luxury pret uses dense slub cotton, fine cambric, pure raw silk and textured khaddar, with sleek cuts and vintage hand-knit references for an autumn wardrobe.

trends.name: Resham garlands and lattice borders
trends.summary: Fall luxury pret features fine resham floral garlands, geometric lattice borders and collar embroidery, finished with scalloped hems, organza panels and buttoned sleeves.

trends.name: Jewel tones replace summer pastels
trends.summary: Autumn collections swap pastels for deep shades such as midnight black, emerald, ochre, terracotta and sapphire, per Zara Shahjahan's fall 2026 pret notes.

trends.name: Sheer organza peshwas
trends.summary: Multi-panelled peshwas in very light sheer organza or net are being pitched for daytime nikkah events and family gatherings ahead of the wedding season.

trends.name: Gota and mukesh over plastic sequins
trends.summary: Handmade metallic gota and mukesh appliqué is favoured over cheap sequins for mehndi and festive wear, alongside tone-on-tone threadwork and white chikankari shadow edges.

trends.name: Festive ready-to-wear instead of tailoring
trends.summary: Shoppers are buying pre-stitched luxury festive outfits rather than waiting on custom tailoring, with ready pieces also used for dholkis and pre-wedding dinners.

trends.name: Farshi gharara revival
trends.summary: Floor-sweeping farshi ghararas, often in jamawar or Banarasi silk, are returning for main wedding days, typically paired with a double-dupatta drape on the barat.

trends.name: Hand vasli, marori and tilla work
trends.summary: Bridal ateliers are leaning back toward hand-guided vasli embroidery, marori threadwork and tilla wiring instead of machine beadwork, with softer drape and historical motifs.

trends.name: Ceremony-coded bridal palette
trends.summary: Bridal guidance maps colour to event: ivory, alabaster or blush for nikkah; deep reds and wine for barat; sage, tea rose and gold for walima.

trends.name: Elongated angrakha-style pishwas
trends.summary: At the December 2025 Bridal Couture Week in Lahore, bridal looks moved toward longer, fluid shapes such as angrakha-cut pishwas, in muted maroon, ivory and cream so the handwork stands out.

trends.name: Fusion groomswear
trends.summary: Menswear at Bridal Couture Week in December 2025 blended sherwanis with suits, waistcoats and structured jackets in browns, blacks and muted neutrals.

trends.name: Pale winter glam for weddings
trends.summary: A January 2026 YOU magazine shoot of Yasmin Zaman pieces showed icy mint, sage, blush and champagne lehengas, sarees and kurtas with dense handwork for winter weddings.

trends.name: Slimmer, quieter menswear
trends.summary: Men's 2026 eastern wear is moving to slimmer kameez, tapered shalwar and minimal detailing in earthy beige, olive, terracotta and brown, with kurtas paired with slim trousers.

trends.name: Textured waistcoats over kurtas
trends.summary: Textured waistcoats in jacquard, raw silk or light embroidery, often in maroon, navy or bottle green, are used to dress up kurtas for winter functions; kurta-trouser pairings are gaining ground at weddings.

trends.name: Craft-led streetwear goes global
trends.summary: Lahore label Rastah, which merges handloom and block printing with streetwear shapes, joined the BoF 500 in 2026; the US is its largest overseas market.

trends.name: Hand block printing in contemporary wear
trends.summary: Rastah's profitability is credited to using traditional hand looms and block printing on streetwear-inflected garments, showing heritage techniques moving into youth fashion.

trends.name: Longer shirts and fuller sleeves
trends.summary: Everyday women's wear in 2026 keeps modest proportions, with longer shirts, fuller sleeves and optional dupattas, while still using colour and print.

trends.name: Relaxed two- and three-piece suits
trends.summary: Straight, relaxed and A-line shirts worn with straight, wide-leg or cigarette trousers dominate everyday two- and three-piece suits, often with the dupatta as the focal point.

trends.name: Eco and year-round fabrics
trends.summary: Retailers note growing interest in organic cotton, bamboo and other lower-impact cloths, plus mid-weight cambric that works across seasons.

trends.name: Woven garments lead export growth
trends.summary: In July-March FY26, Pakistan's woven (non-knit) apparel exports grew about 3.8% while knitwear slipped, making finished garments the most resilient part of textile exports.

trends.name: Quiet-luxury pastel co-ords
trends.summary: Summer 2026 favoured solid pastel two-piece sets with contrast stitching, botanical watercolour prints and mid-length straight shirts with wide culottes.

trends.name: Digital printing on lawn
trends.summary: Lawn guidance for summer 2026 credited digital printing with sharper detail and smoother colour gradation, used for cleaner floral and nature motifs.

trends.name: Zoomed florals and reworked paisley
trends.summary: Global SS27 print forecasts point to oversized close-up florals, soft-focus gradients and a paisley revival; relevant to Pakistan's 2027 lawn season, though not Pakistan-specific.

trends.name: Nautical, gingham and retro geometrics for kids
trends.summary: SS27 kidswear print forecasts highlight sea-creature and anchor motifs, vintage geometric shapes and gingham mixed with fruit or flowers; a global signal for 2027 kids lawn and casual lines.

trends.name: Early-March Eid 2027 window
trends.summary: Eid ul-Fitr 2027 is expected around 9-11 March, subject to moon sighting, so Eid festive launches will fall at the end of winter in 2027.
